pages.useful_because: The homepage shows Dellona Electric's own job photos, each captioned with what it shows: a JuiceBox EV charger on a garage wall, two electricians running conduit to a Kohler standby generator at a log home, panel work in a basement, recessed and pendant lighting in a new kitchen, a restaurant bar's pendant lighting, and the lettered truck and trailer on a new-build lot. It names the owner (Edward Giannoni), the Briar Bluff Rd base in Reedsburg, the 2018 founding year and the full list of 15 services. It also answers the questions a Reedsburg customer asks before calling: service area, how pricing works, Wisconsin permits, EV chargers on a dedicated 240-volt circuit, generator transfer switches, and new construction and commercial work.
